[color=#ff1c18]CARDS & INTERACTIONS[/color]

   [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff8864]Cards[/color] are your main [color=#ff8864]tools[/color] for [color=#ff1c18]INTERACTING[/color]. They represent [color=#ff1c18]ACTIONS[/color], [color=#ff1c18]DYNAMICS[/color], [color=#ff1c18]OBJECTS[/color], [color=#ff1c18]LOCATIONS[/color] or [color=#ff1c18]CHARACTERS[/color].

   [color=#ffffff]-[/color] CARD TYPES
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff1c18]DIALOGUE[/color], [color=#ff1c18]INVESTIGATION[/color] and [color=#ff1c18]COMBAT[/color]: Interaction cards used to [color=#ff8864]interrogate[/color] Characters, [color=#ff8864]search[/color] locations and [color=#ff8864]fight[/color].
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff1c18]ABSTRACT[/color]: Cards representing a [color=#ff8864]dynamic[/color] for the action undertaken, along with its [color=#ff8864]advantages[/color] (and [color=#ff8864]disadvantages[/color])...
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff1c18]CHARACTER[/color], [color=#ff1c18]OBJECT[/color] and [color=#ff1c18]LOCATION[/color]: Represent [color=#ff8864]Characters[/color], [color=#ff8864]Objects[/color] and [color=#ff8864]Locations[/color] (Oh?).

   [color=#ffffff]-[/color] CARD HANDS
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff1c18]MASTERY HAND[/color]: Contains the [color=#ff8864]cards[/color] you have [color=#ff1c18]mastered[/color], granting you a [color=#ff8864]bonus[/color]. Limit of [color=#ff1c18]10[/color] [color=#ff8864]cards[/color] (incl. max. [color=#ff1c18]3[/color] [color=#ff8864]Abstract cards[/color]).
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff1c18]FALLBACK HAND[/color]: Contains [color=#ff1c18]random[/color] [color=#ff8864]cards[/color] that you have [color=#ff1c18]not mastered[/color] but think you [color=#ff8864]could use[/color].
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff1c18]EVIDENCE[/color]: Contains [color=#ff8864]Object[/color] and [color=#ff8864]Character[/color] cards [color=#ff8864]you[/color] qualified as [color=#ff1c18]Evidence[/color].
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff1c18]OBJECTS[/color], [color=#ff1c18]LOCATIONS[/color] and [color=#ff1c18]CHARACTERS[/color]: Contain [color=#ff8864]Object[/color], [color=#ff8864]Location[/color] and [color=#ff8864]Character[/color] cards (Oh?).

   [color=#ffffff]-[/color] USING CARDS
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff1c18]DRAG & DROP[/color] (with [color=#ff8864]Left-Click[/color]): To [color=#ff8864]play[/color] or [color=#ff8864]move[/color] a card.
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff1c18]RIGHT-CLICK[/color]: To [color=#ff8864]interact[/color] with a card then [color=#ff8864]select an action[/color] in the [color=#ff8864]menu[/color].
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff1c18]LEFT-CLICK[/color]: To [color=#ff8864]keep focus[/color] on a [color=#ff8864]card[/color].

   [color=#ffffff]-[/color] INTERACTIONS
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] Mainly, you play a [color=#ff1c18]minimum[/color] of [color=#ff1c18]1 card[/color] and a [color=#ff1c18]maximum[/color] of [color=#ff1c18]3 cards[/color], only [color=#ff1c18]1[/color] of [color=#ff1c18]each kind[/color].
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff1c18]DIALOGUE[/color]: [color=#ff8864]Dialogue[/color], [color=#ff8864]Object[/color]/[color=#ff8864]Location[/color]/[color=#ff8864]Character[/color]/[color=#ff8864]Evidence[/color], and [color=#ff8864]Abstract[/color].
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff1c18]INVESTIGATION[/color] & [color=#ff1c18]COMBAT[/color]: [color=#ff8864]Investigation[/color] or [color=#ff8864]Combat[/color], [color=#ff8864]SPECIAL[/color], and [color=#ff8864]Abstract[/color].
	  [color=#ffffff]-[/color] [color=#ff8864]*[/color][color=#ff1c18]BREAK-IN[/color] & [color=#ff8864]*[/color][color=#ff1c18]RUN-AWAY[/color]: With a [color=#ff1c18]BREAK-IN[/color] or a [color=#ff1c18]RUN-AWAY[/color] card (plus possibly [color=#ff1c18]1[/color] [color=#ff8864]Abstract[/color]) or [color=#ff1c18]no card[/color] [color=#ff8864]at all[/color][color=#ff1c18][shake rate=7.0 level=5 connected=0]...[/shake][/color]
